subject: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR, VSQ, private VPC options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finhealth.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR, VSQ, private VPC options

Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about FinHealth's roadmap and regulatory constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2 / Compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in progress (audit started Q1 2027, expected completion Q3 2027). We currently provide SOC 2 Type I report and can share a summary of controls and our interim evidence. For HIPAA/GDPR: we support data residency controls, encryption at rest/in transit, and contractual BAA/GDPR addenda where required.

- Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ): Attached is our standard VSQ (xlsx). If you prefer we can ingest your vendor questionnaire and have our security team return answers within 5 business days.

- Private deployment options: We discussed three paths — Hosted (isolated tenancy), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), and Private VPC/on-prem. For the VPC/private option we can provide a deployment diagram (attached high-level), KMS integration steps, and an air-gapped/on-prem package for regulated workloads.

Action items / Proposed next steps:
1) Alex: please confirm which vendor questionnaire you want us to complete (we can take the Excel you use or answer ours).
2) FinHealth: confirm whether you need a BAA and if PHI will be processed.
3) Redwood: we will prepare a short packet (SOC 2 summary, GDPR checklist, deployment diagram) and target to return the completed VSQ within 5 business days after we get your questionnaire.
4) Let's set a 30-minute follow-up with security + infra next week to go through the deployment diagram and networking details (peering, NAT, Egress controls).

I attached our VSQ template and a first-pass deployment diagram that shows VPC peering, NAT egress, and optional on-prem air-gap.

If any of that needs to change, tell me and we'll adapt. Available slots for a follow-up: Wed 4/6 09:00-11:00 PT or Thu 4/7 13:00-15:00 PT.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0104

Attachments: finhealth_vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 210KB); redwood_deployment_diagram_v1.png (png, 420KB)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR, VSQ, private VPC options

Thanks Marcus — useful recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- VSQ: Please complete the attached FinHealth vendor questionnaire (I uploaded it to the shared Drive link). We need the detailed mappings for encryption, access controls, and incident response. Target turnaround is 5-7 business days.
- SOC 2: FinHealth requires SOC 2 Type II evidence prior to Prod access for workloads that handle PHI. If Redwood can provide interim controls and a timeline (audit firm, start/completion), that will help our risk team.
- BAA / PHI: Yes, we will likely process PHI in the pilot. Please have your legal contact reach out about a BAA draft.
- Deployment: We want the private VPC option with customer-managed peering. Air-gapped on-prem would be ideal for Phase 2. In the immediate term, please detail network isolation (subnet design, flow logs, audit logging, egress restrictions) in the diagram.

I'll drop the questionnaire in the Drive folder and add notes on the high-risk items we need prioritized. Available for the follow-up: Wed 4/6 09:30 PT works for our security lead.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Turner
Head of IT Security, FinHealth Inc.
alex.turner@finhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0212

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up: SOC 2, GDPR, VSQ, private VPC options

Alex — quick note from the GTM side. Happy to join the follow-up to map procurement timelines and expected contract milestones. From experience with similar customers, if SOC 2 Type II timing is a blocker we can propose a guarded pilot with limited scope and contractual guardrails (data scoping, minimum retention, escrow audit rights).

Marcus — can you include a short summary of the guarded pilot template in the packet? That will help procurement speed review.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finhealth.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@finhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security & deployment follow-up: Security packet + next steps / follow-up scheduling

Alex / Samantha — attaching the requested items and next steps: 

1) Attached: Completed FinHealth VSQ (answers in the "Redwood Responses" tab), SOC 2 summary (Type I + Type II timeline), GDPR checklist, BAA request template, and an updated deployment diagram with subnet details, flow log placement, and KMS integration notes.
2) We flagged items where our security team needs further input (PHI data flows, expected egress domains, and on-prem lift-and-shift constraints). These are highlighted in the VSQ.
3) Proposed timeline: once you confirm VSQ receipt, Redwood security will schedule a 60-minute technical walkthrough (security + infra) within 3 business days. Pilot proposal and guarded-scope contract language can be ready within one week.

Confirming Wed 4/6 09:30 PT with your security lead works for us — I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (deployment walk-through, VSQ open items, BAA touchpoint).

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0104

Attachments: FinHealth_VSQ_completed_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 360KB); redwood_soc2_summary_q1_2027.pdf (pdf, 95KB); redwood_deployment_diagram_v2.png (png, 540KB)
